text: Active UI theme is Blue. The system supports 6 custom themes: Blue, White, Dark, Red, Green, and Yellow.
Architecture follows strict 10-step self-development with isolated checkpoints, permission gates, and rollback guarantees.
Discussion on custom high-top sneakers: obsidian black and cobalt blue colorway with gum sole, minimalist silhouette, premium breathable leather.
Offline first: Base intelligence operates without an external API key. Tool primitives validate file paths and require passkey for core self-modification.
